title: Power of asymptotics
formal:
There are these two simple OEIS sequences that are surprisingly the same for a very long time. I would not be surprised if they were even record-holders or close to being record-holders among OEIS sequences in how long they agree.  
[https://oeis.org/A078608](https://oeis.org/A078608)
[https://oeis.org/A129935](https://oeis.org/A129935)
[https://oeis.org/A078608/a078608.pdf](https://oeis.org/A078608/a078608.pdf)
Explaining why this is so is relatively doable -- you have to use Taylor series to rewrite one of those sequences to \lceil 2n/log 2 - 1 + 0.05... \* 1/n + something small \rceil. Then, basically for every n, there is a "probability" of 0.05.../n that the two sequences differ. Harmonic series goes to infinity but only very slowly, so the two sequences will differ at some points when 2n/log 2 happens to be very close to integer.
